recognitionRules: Use Copperplate display lettering between restrained horizontal rules.

editorialSource.overview: A portrait, two-slide workshop poster and programme. Teal #073E47 text sits on a cream field; narrow gold #966B28 rules divide key areas. The first slide centers one embedded book image between the large title and event details. The second uses an editable programme table above two closing columns.
invariants: The source requests Copperplate for title, date and section labels, and Arial for supporting copy. The local LibreOffice PDF uses FrankRuhlHofshi-Bold and LiberationSans resources; these describe that render, not the requested fonts.
The shared full-width text/rule geometry begins at x=457200 and spans w=6858000 EMUs; the second slide's lower columns begin at x=457200 and x=4086225.
The central artwork is one embedded picture shape, not editable vector components. Event identity, date, venue, contact and demo footer are fictional source content.
adaptationChecks: Fit edited titles within the slide 1 and slide 2 title boxes at their chosen display sizes; inspect both rendered slides for overflow.
Keep the edited programme table above the lower label row at y=7667625 EMUs, or deliberately reflow that area.
Check access text, booking contact and image rights or replacement alt text before sharing a real event poster.

visualFidelityReview.scope: Native rendered cover/desktop preview reviewed on 104-identity contact boards; discrepancies opened individually. Native XML corroborates exact values. This does not claim every page was visually inspected.
visualFidelityReview.logoBoundary: The authored brand wordmark and symbol are new editorial proposals unless separately identified as preserved source geometry; supporting native artwork and functional color roles are not replaced by the new logo.

accessibility.scope: Calculated solid-color reading pair only. Accent text, controls, image overlays, font rendering, small marks and final layouts require application-specific review. Decorative palette colors are not automatically valid text colors.

logoProduction.decision: Use CEDAR HOUSE in Copperplate above a stepped rule, with WORKSHOPS as a smaller descriptor. A corner-step motif may frame signs without becoming a crest.
logoProduction.productionMethod: Brand-specific outlined typography with deco-steps source mechanism. Precise native geometry; no raster masquerading as SVG.
logoProduction.productionNotes: Self-contained SVG masters contain real paths. PNG exports are rendered at 2x with MuPDF. No raster is described as editable vector. Source family substitutions are explicit in fontsUsed and brand-font-plan.
